result.title: From Prediction to Decision: Decision-Focused Fine-Tuning of Autoregressive Tabular Transformers for Cost-Sensitive Financial Events
result.summary: Autoregressive transformers trained on tokenized tabular event streams are a simple and strong baseline for predicting financial events such as fraud. Yet institutions do not act on probabilities; they act on decisions whose consequences are asymmetric and heteroscedastic: the cost of a missed high-value fraud and that of a wrongly declined small purchase are not the same. The standard bridge is post-hoc Bayes-optimal thresholding of calibrated probabilities under a cost matrix. We ask whether fine-tuning the model to the decision objective can do better. We fine-tune the same pretrained model so that its restricted softmax over label tokens (already a distribution over business actions) maximizes expected utility under an institution-specified, amount-scaled cost matrix. Because the reward is a known function of (action, outcome, amount) and the outcome is observed in the data, the expected-utility objective and its gradient are available in closed form. This is example-dependent cost-sensitive learning whose per-example loss is linear in the predicted probability, with no sampling, critics, or advantage estimation. A KL anchor to the pretrained model and an auxiliary language-modeling term preserve calibration and the generative event model. A sampled, group-normalized (GRPO-style) variant provides the extension point to trajectory-level rewards.

AI.brief_summary: 论文对预训练自回归表格 transformer 做决策导向微调，使标签 token 上的受限 softmax 在金额缩放的代价矩阵下直接最大化期望效用，并加入 KL 锚与辅助语言建模项以保持校准，另给出 GRPO 风格变体。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「直接用非对称效用目标训练输出分布、而非事后阈值」及 KL 锚定做法，可供核查是否能用于 LVR 的答案使用与停止决策训练，但该工作无视觉输入与 latent 状态，迁移效果未验证。
